audience: teams that run webinars and follow up with registrants in LiveWebinar

useCases.title: Review the webinars and sessions of an account
useCases.text: List the webinar rooms of the account and open one to see its start date and timezone. List its sessions to see each live run and its state.

useCases.title: Count and review the registrants of a webinar
useCases.text: List the people who registered for one webinar. Open one registrant to read the answers from the registration form before you follow up.

useCases.title: See who joined a session of a webinar
useCases.text: List the sessions of a webinar, then list the participants of one session with their roles and online state.

useCases.title: Review the polls of a webinar
useCases.text: List the polls of one webinar with their questions and the active poll session.

useCases.title: Create a scheduled webinar from a request
useCases.text: Create a scheduled webinar in the account with a start time in a timezone and a length. Ask for it only when you want a new webinar.
